groups.activity: Stage Defense — defend Flare/Temple; queue via the bounty stage, not the plain node
groups.meta: AABC rotations; 390 Heartstrings for the full blueprint set

rows.label: Temple Blueprint
rows.note: 195 Heartstrings at Flare Varleon, Central Mall

conditions: Each rotation is 3 waves, running AABC; after the first rotation the floor collapses into an underground encore arena with Techrot added.
Temporal Archimedea's Stage Defense stages do not award Heartstrings, confirmed on the wiki and by a player who checked.
Heartstrings are not affected by Resource Boosters (fixed in Hotfix 38.5.1).
bonuses: Every rotation also pays 4-9 Heartstrings (7-12 Steel Path) even without a blueprint drop, banking toward the 390-Heartstring full set.
The farm also earns Hex standing and Screamer arcane drops at the same time.
Queue through the Höllvania bounty version rather than the plain map node — public matchmaking fills the bounty stage while the node runs nearly empty.

disclosures.title: go Steel Path
disclosures.body: Near-unanimous advice: Steel Path pays more Heartstrings per rotation (7-12 vs 4-9), more enemies means faster waves, and Steel Essence comes along for free. Roughly 390 Heartstrings works out to about 40 Steel Path rotations or 60 normal ones before any lucky drops; one player reported a full set on currency alone in under 3 hours, about 130 waves.

disclosures.title: frame picks
disclosures.body: Mesa (Regulators auto-target everything in the open arena, ~3 min/rotation) is the most-recommended farmer. Also named: Hildryn with a Balefire build, Nova, Protea (handles flying enemies), Gara, Mirage, Volt, and the semi-AFK picks Octavia and Nokko. Bring something that kills the Scaldra Screamer fast — a suicide bomber with nullifying pulses that spawns on the last wave of each rotation.
